description: Figure 2 illustrates the training loss as a function of training steps for several model types and sizes, using a dataset of 20 million data points. The x-axis is labeled “Steps” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5000, with tick labels at intervals of 500. The y-axis is labeled “Loss” and also has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5.  There are six lines displayed. A solid blue line, marked with circle-shaped data points, begins at approximately 4.6 at step 0 and decreases to approximately 0.2 at step 5000. A solid orange line, marked with square-shaped data points, starts at approximately 4.6 at step 0 and decreases to approximately 0.3 at step 5000. A solid green line, marked with diamond-shaped data points, begins at approximately 4.6 at step 0 and decreases to approximately 0.25 at step 5000. A dashed blue line begins at approximately 4.6 at step 0 and decreases to approximately 0.3 at step 5000. A dashed orange line begins at approximately 4.6 at step 0 and decreases to approximately 0.35 at step 5000. A dashed green line begins at approximately 4.6 at step 0 and decreases to approximately 0.3 at step 5000. All lines demonstrate a decreasing trend across the x-axis.
